start.title: The Garden Gate
start.text:
Olive trees breathe in the moonlight.
The hour you knew was coming has come.

choices.feedback: The Father waits inside.
You step beneath the boughs.

choices.text: Send them all back to the city
choices.feedback: Take at least the three with you.

back_consequence.title: Not Away
back_consequence.text:
This cup will not pass by retreat.
Walk into the garden, not away.

choices.feedback: You set your face toward prayer.

send_consequence.title: Keep the Three
send_consequence.text:
Peter, James, and John must witness.
This night will shape their hearts.

choices.feedback: You beckon them forward.

inner_circle.title: Stay and Watch
inner_circle.text:
Peter, James, John look up at you.
"My soul is sorrowful unto death."

choices.feedback: Let them see the weight you bear.
They nod, eyes wide and afraid.

choices.text: Demand they fight off any threat
choices.feedback: Prayer, not swords, tonight.

hide_consequence.title: Let Them See
hide_consequence.text:
Your honesty becomes their training.
Love does not hide its tears.

choices.feedback: They sit beneath an olive tree.

demand_consequence.title: Not by Force
demand_consequence.text:
The Father's will is not won by swords.
This hour calls for prayer.

choices.feedback: You lower your voice gently.

stone_alone.title: A Stone's Throw
stone_alone.text:
A pale moon-lit rock waits ahead.
You step away from your friends.

choices.text: Stand and shout at the sky
choices.feedback: Kneel. Speak as a son.

choices.text: Fall to your knees in prayer
choices.feedback: Your knees press the cold earth.

choices.text: Demand the Father change His plan
choices.feedback: Ask, do not demand.

shout_consequence.title: As a Son
shout_consequence.text:
Heaven hears the quiet word too.
Kneel as the beloved Son.

choices.text: Fall to your knees in prayer
choices.feedback: You bow low to the ground.

demand_father_consequence.title: Ask, Don't Demand
demand_father_consequence.text:
Trust does not force the Father's hand.
It opens its own.

choices.text: Fall to your knees in prayer
choices.feedback: You sink down in surrender.

anguish.title: The Cup Before You
anguish.text:
Your breath shakes. A tear falls.
The cup of suffering is so heavy.

choices.feedback: Speak truth, then surrender.

choices.text: Pretend the fear is not real
choices.feedback: Honesty opens the way to peace.
Your words rise into the night.

refuse_consequence.title: Speak, Then Yield
refuse_consequence.text:
Name the fear. Then offer it.
Not refusal, but trust.

choices.feedback: Your voice breaks softly.

pretend_consequence.title: Be Honest
pretend_consequence.text:
The Father knows your every fear.
Bring it openly to Him.

choices.feedback: The words come from deep within.

submission.title: Your Will Be Done
submission.text:
Silence answers from heaven.
What shall you say next?

choices.feedback: Even silence is the Father near.
A deep peace settles in your bones.

choices.text: Stand and walk away from prayer
choices.feedback: Stay until the surrender is full.

curse_consequence.title: The Father Is Near
curse_consequence.text:
He does not abandon the obedient.
Speak the harder, truer word.

choices.feedback: Peace returns like a quiet tide.

walk_away_consequence.title: Stay in Surrender
walk_away_consequence.text:
The hour requires more than presence.
It asks for yes.

choices.feedback: The words become a covenant.

find_sleeping_1.title: Could You Not Watch?
find_sleeping_1.text:
You return. Peter, James, John sleep.
Their lamps lie low beside them.

choices.feedback: Compassion, not anger, here.

choices.text: Wake them and call them to pray
choices.feedback: "The spirit is willing, the flesh weak."

choices.text: Leave them and never come back
choices.feedback: You must return to the Father.

anger_consequence.title: Compassion First
anger_consequence.text:
Their weakness is not your enemy.
Meet it with gentleness.

choices.text: Wake them and call them to pray
choices.feedback: Peter opens heavy eyes.

leave_consequence.title: Return to the Father
leave_consequence.text:
Surrender is not finished yet.
Go back, and pray again.

choices.text: Wake them and call them to pray
choices.feedback: You speak softly to each one.

pray_again.title: A Second Time
pray_again.text:
You walk back to the stone alone.
What will you offer the Father now?

choices.text: Beg only for an easier path
choices.feedback: Trust, not bargain.
The same yes, deeper this time.

choices.text: Stand silent and refuse to pray
choices.feedback: Prayer is the strength of this hour.

easier_consequence.title: Trust the Plan
easier_consequence.text:
The Father's path leads through, not around.
Walk the road of yes.

choices.feedback: Strength rises from the surrender.

silent_consequence.title: Pray Through It
silent_consequence.text:
The hour gains power through prayer.
Do not face it mute.

choices.feedback: Heaven steadies your heart.

find_sleeping_2.title: Asleep Again
find_sleeping_2.text:
They could not keep their eyes open.
Their heads rest against each other.

choices.feedback: Their hearts are with you still.

choices.text: Let them rest, return to pray
choices.feedback: You walk back without a word.

choices.text: Wake them and flee the garden
choices.feedback: The hour is not for fleeing.

mock_consequence.title: They Are With You
mock_consequence.text:
Their bodies fail; their love does not.
Let mercy cover their sleep.

choices.text: Let them rest, return to pray
choices.feedback: You touch a shoulder gently.

flee_consequence.title: Stand Your Ground
flee_consequence.text:
Obedience does not run tonight.
It rises and walks forward.

choices.text: Let them rest, return to pray
choices.feedback: You move quietly back to the rock.

final_resolve.title: The Hour Has Come
final_resolve.text:
Dawn light bleeds across the hills.
Footsteps echo on the far path.

choices.feedback: Rise. The hour will not be hidden from.
"Rise. Let us go."

choices.text: Pray a fourth time in panic
choices.feedback: The surrender is complete now.

hide_trees_consequence.title: Not Hidden
hide_trees_consequence.text:
The Father's will is to be met.
Walk into the morning openly.

choices.feedback: You stand to your full height.

fourth_consequence.title: It Is Finished Here
fourth_consequence.text:
The cup is taken in your hands.
Go now to drink it for love.

choices.feedback: Your peace is unshaken.

ending.title: Rise, Let Us Go
ending.text:
Your three friends stand beside you.
Dawn breaks. The path leads onward.
